summary: GDEV Inc., a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026 reporting results of its 2026 annual general meeting held the same day in Limassol, Cyprus. All agenda items were approved by majority of votes cast: re-election of three independent directors (Marie Holive, Andrew Sheppard, Tal Shoham) and adoption of amended and restated Memorandum and Articles of Association. No special-situation event such as acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring occurred. The filing is routine corporate governance disclosure, not a special situation.
